capabilities: Embed the DeepSeek Harness web UI in a sidebar iframe
Start, stop and restart the local dsh web server on a free port
Install a graphify bridge that gives agents graphify_search and graphify_stats tools over pre-extracted concepts
Configure CLI path, port, embed mode and extra server arguments
Inspect server logs and open the panel URL in the default browser
disambiguation: Not a standalone AI chat plugin; it embeds and manages the external DeepSeek Harness application inside a sidebar panel.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.4.0+) because it spawns a local process; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; all traffic stays on 127.0.0.1 with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run external AI agents from inside the vault without switching to another app or terminal.

relations.evidence: Claudian — the Obsidian plugin that inspired embedding an AI agent in a sidebar panel.
the VS Code extension whose spawn/ready-line and cookie-proxy approach this plugin follows

requires.name: Model credentials configured in DSH (e.g. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY)

summary: Sidebar panel that embeds the DeepSeek Harness web UI in Obsidian, manages its local server, and optionally gives agents a local knowledge graph.
